blocking_findings.scope: musaf_repetition_shofarot_verses (HE/EN), poem:anusah_leezrah quote contexts (HE/EN), registry-additions-v3 siddur.jsonl and poem.jsonl
blocking_findings.finding: The verse beginning וכל העם ראים את הקולת is identified as exodus/20/15 in the repetition Shofarot verses and in the Anusah quote contexts. Evidence: the bible-source-projection-proof lists exodus/20/15 for both. It is also in the registry rows shofarot_verses/intro_exodus_20_15, quotes/exodus_20/15, anusah_leezrah/exodus_20_15/... and quotes/exodus_20/15. Under JLPTEI-3 Versification, the canonical (Leningrad) division numbers Exodus 20 with 26 verses: 20:15 is לא תגנב and וכל העם is 20:18. The existing Musaf file musaf_shofarot_verses.xml already uses exodus/20/18 for this same text. The guideline also says: 'Never renumber to paper over a disagreement.'
blocking_findings.required_action: Remap to exodus/20/18 in both projects. Rename the registry rows that are named after the verse (e.g. exodus_20_18). Rerun the source projection against a canonical-numbered witness.

blocking_findings.finding: The report does not back up the claim that the 882 XML files pass formal schema validation. It reads status 'UNACCEPTED XML only', counts.actual=1, identical_previously_validated=881, validated_xml_digests=933, and has no pass/fail field. The manifest shows about 40 files changed in V3, so a count of one 'actual' file does not cover the changed set.
blocking_findings.required_action: Provide a validation receipt that lists, for each V3 changed file, its SHA (matching the manifest) and an explicit pass result.

blocking_findings.finding: Both files carry the identical printed words from pp. 5-6, including the same pb n=6 break. The Minchah context file has the full liturgical text directly in its body, with no j:transclude, no seg/@source and no prayer milestone pointing to the canonical identity. This breaks SIDDUR_URN_SCHEME's 'same text in several contexts' rule (reach shared words by transclusion or milestones) and the siddur: rule ('holds no words of its own'). It also leaves the same printed page encoded twice in one project.
blocking_findings.required_action: Have the Minchah context transclude the canonical word module, or wrap its words in seg/@source plus milestones to the canonical URN. Keep pagination in only one place.

nonblocking_findings: Transliteration in new canonical stanza URNs: essa_dei_betzedeq/hakhshal (הָכְשַׁל, hof'al, qamatz qatan) should be 'hokhshal', and essa_dei_betzedeq/haonash (הָעֳנַשׁ, qamatz qatan + hataf qamatz) should be 'hoonash'. Before 1.0 a rename is free, so fix before committing the registry.

Inconsistent group naming in the Anusah quote contexts: 'psalm_150' vs 'psalms_47_6_98_6' and 'psalms_81_4_5'. Also, these groups are named by reference, not by incipit; acceptable as quotation groupings, but should be consistent.

Registry status inconsistency: the Anusah quote-context URNs (poem:anusah_leezrah/.../quotes/...) are registered status=canonical, while the equivalent repetition quote contexts are status=context. JLPTEI-3 (lines 220-227) treats quote-context URNs as bounded contextual identities, not canonical verses.

Header titles of amidah_modim_derabbanan_parts.xml and amidah_modim_derabbanan.xml are 'תפלת מנחה — modim_derabbanan': a raw ASCII identifier inside the Hebrew main title. The canonical word library is also labeled as Minchah.

verdict: NOT APPROVED. There are three blocking issues. (1) A versification error: וכל העם ראים is encoded as exodus/20/15 instead of canonical exodus/20/18 in the repetition Shofarot verses, the Anusah quote contexts, the registry additions and the projection proof, contradicting the existing musaf_shofarot_verses.xml. (2) The schema-validation report does not show the V3 changed files were validated. (3) The Minchah Modim derabbanan context duplicates the canonical word module's words with no transclusion or @source. Several requested inputs were not read: the realization payloads, the prior reports, the alignment and stanza tables, the settings, some headers and several new-to-review canonical event streams. So realization bindings and full guideline adherence cannot be approved, and all_requested_checks_completed is false.
